The stock trades at $178.56 (+5.09%) as of Nov 4, 12:25 PM EST. That is well below the after-hours print of $188.69, which was +11.05% and stamped 3:55 AM EST, so part of the overnight pop has already faded. The 52-week range is $114.52–$217.41.
